lifecycle.freeze_rule: Canonical authority bytes are immutable after review. Frozen standing may be created only by a separate create-last freeze record binding the exact authority SHA-256 and accepted review SHA-256. Any authority byte change creates a successor revision requiring fresh review.

title: Construct a 13-channel sorting network with at most 44 comparators

mathematical_premises.comparator_semantics: For comparator [i,j] with i<j, replace positions i,j by min(value_i,value_j), max(value_i,value_j).
mathematical_premises.network_semantics: A candidate is one fixed ordered comparator sequence applied identically to every input; no input-dependent choice, preprocessing, hidden state, or variable-length execution is permitted.
mathematical_premises.zero_one_principle: A comparator network sorts arbitrary totally ordered inputs iff it sorts every Boolean input of the same channel count.

required_boolean_input_set.encoding: integers 0 through 8191 inclusive, each exactly once under verifier A direct enumeration

candidate_encoding.semantic_shape: JSON array of comparator arrays; each comparator is exactly [i,j].
candidate_encoding.raw_search_output: Preserve separately as provenance; raw search bytes never receive witness identity.

canonicalization.json_tokens: arrays and base-10 integer number tokens only; no booleans, strings, nulls, objects, floats, exponents, NaN, Infinity, comments, duplicate wrapper fields, or coercion
canonicalization.separators: comma and colon with no following spaces
canonicalization.integer_lexeme: canonical base-10 digits with no leading plus sign and no leading zeros except the single token 0
canonicalization.identity: SHA-256 of the exact canonical bytes

candidate_encoding.normalization_rule: The canonicalizer may serialize a successfully parsed semantic comparator list into the frozen canonical byte form but may not reorder, reverse, add, delete, deduplicate, repair, or otherwise alter comparators. Original raw search output is preserved separately.

SORTS_ALL_13_BIT_INPUTS.meaning: The exact comparator sequence sorts all 8192 Boolean inputs.
SORTS_ALL_13_BIT_INPUTS.applies_to: baseline controls and candidate networks of any explicitly permitted control length
SORTS_ALL_13_BIT_INPUTS.pass_rule: No unsorted output exists over the exact 8192-input Boolean domain.

ADMISSIBLE_WITNESS.meaning: The exact canonical candidate is a valid witness for this pass.
pass_rule: both frozen independent verifier decision cores agree PASS on exact candidate identity

baseline_45.role: positive sorting-property control only; it is intentionally NOT an admissible witness because comparator_count is 45

source_context.name: Bert Dobbelaere sorting-network compilation / SorterHunter
source_context.retrieved_context: Public compilation lists the exact 13-input 45-comparator, 10-layer construction and size interval 44...45.
source_context.standing_role: context/control provenance only; mathematical candidate validity never depends on a live web page

required_control_outcomes: SORTS_ALL_13_BIT_INPUTS == PASS for the exact 45-comparator baseline
ADMISSIBLE_WITNESS == FAIL solely because comparator_count is 45
each of the 45 single-comparator deletion mutants has SORTS_ALL_13_BIT_INPUTS == FAIL

parser_negative_controls: more than two elements in a comparator
more than 44 comparators for witness admissibility

verifier_a.coverage_rule: enumerate exactly integer inputs 0..8191 once each; decode each into 13 Boolean channel values under an explicitly tested bit-to-channel convention
verifier_a.failure_output: at least one exact unsorted input and output

verifier_b.decision_core: bit-parallel truth-table propagation or SAT/SMT search for an unsorted Boolean counterexample; must not use verifier A decision code or verdict
verifier_b.structural_independence: must use a different state representation and algorithmic decision path from verifier A
verifier_b.cross_language_rule: mandatory if a second standard runtime is available in the execution environment; otherwise record the unavailable runtime and compensate with differential fixtures plus fresh outside-derivation review

required_differential_controls: duplicate one Boolean input while omitting another
verification_architecture.outside_derivation_requirement: Before any candidate receives standing, at least one major check of the problem/control semantics or candidate replay must originate outside the implementation derivation chain, such as an independently sourced public control plus a fresh independent reviewer/replay.

frontier_snapshot.lower_bound_policy: No lower-bound value is required for or granted authority by this constructive pass.
frontier_snapshot.final_frontier_rule: Before public reporting, perform a fresh external frontier check. A valid witness establishes S(13) <= candidate_length regardless of novelty. Novelty/priority is a separate contextual statement and is never implied by WITNESS_FOUND_AND_VERIFIED.

search_rules.diagnostic_control: Search machinery may use the 45-comparator baseline only as a known-good diagnostic target under a separately labeled diagnostic path; novel witness emission remains <=44.

standing_dependencies.authority_change: revokes all downstream standing under the superseded authority
standing_dependencies.verifier_change: stales verifier qualification, candidate verification, dependent reviews, and final disposition; search-performance evidence is unaffected unless it declares verifier dependency
standing_dependencies.search_change: stales only search-method/performance evidence and candidate provenance produced by changed search code; frozen verifier evidence remains standing absent an explicit dependency
standing_dependencies.candidate_change: creates a new candidate identity and invalidates candidate-specific verification/review
standing_dependencies.evidence_regeneration: stales reviews bound to the prior evidence summary
standing_dependencies.frontier_change: does not affect mathematical witness validity; it affects only contextual novelty statements

dispositions.WITNESS_FOUND_AND_VERIFIED: A canonical <=44 comparator candidate has standing verification under the frozen authority. This establishes S(13) <= candidate_length. It does not establish optimality, novelty priority, or a lower bound.
dispositions.SEARCH_EXHAUSTED_WITHOUT_RESOLUTION: Authorized search budget ended without a standing witness. The mathematical problem remains unresolved and no lower-bound or nonexistence claim is permitted.
dispositions.METHOD_NEEDS_REPAIR: Frozen authority is sound but verifier, search, evidence, review, or execution machinery has repairable defects.
dispositions.AUTHORITY_REVISION_REQUIRED: Frozen authority is contradictory or insufficient and must be superseded.
dispositions.METHOD_NOT_VIABLE: The planned approach cannot be made trustworthy within declared constraints.

prohibitions: Do not claim that 45 comparators are necessary.
Do not infer nonexistence or a lower bound from search failure, timeout, SAT UNKNOWN, heuristic exhaustion, or model judgment.
Do not let a searcher, candidate generator, verifier caller, or LLM assert verification standing.
Do not change canonical authority bytes after their accepted review; freeze them only through a separate binding record.
Do not change candidate acceptance rules, verifier rules, review severities, or search budget after inspecting a promising candidate.
Do not delete failed candidates, failed qualifications, failed searches, unavailable reviews, or rejected reviews.
Do not claim novelty or priority from mathematical verification alone.
